description: This file defines the internal SocketConnection class responsible for managing socket-based network connections within the Orleans networking framework. It handles connection lifecycle, data reception, data transmission, error handling, and connection shutdowns using async patterns and pipes.

classes.name: SocketConnection
classes.description: Sealed internal class managing a network socket connection, including sending, receiving, error handling, and lifecycle management tactics.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the asynchronous processing of socket send and receive loops.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Internal async method that runs the receive and send tasks and manages cleanup and error logs.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Initiates a graceful shutdown of the connection using a provided reason.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously disposes the connection resources, marking the transport input and output as complete.

methods.name: DoReceive
methods.description: Main method for processing incoming data, with error handling and connection state updates.

methods.name: ProcessReceives
methods.description: Loop that reads data from the socket and writes into the input pipe.

methods.name: DoSend
methods.description: Main method for processing outgoing data from the output pipe.

methods.name: ProcessSends
methods.description: Loop that reads data from the output pipe and sends it via the socket.

methods.name: FireConnectionClosed
methods.description: Marks the connection as closed and triggers associated cleanup tasks.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Performs the shutdown sequence: sets flags, logs, shuts down the socket, and disposes of resources.

methods.name: CancelConnectionClosedToken
methods.description: Cancels the connection closed token to signal the connection shutdown.

methods.name: IsConnectionResetError
methods.description: Checks if a socket error code indicates a connection reset.

methods.name: IsConnectionAbortError
methods.description: Checks if a socket error code indicates an abort error.
